releasePlan.notes: String multivariate flag (control/v1). Evaluated in init() AFTER await initLaunchDarkly() to avoid the ordering risk identified in the brief. Control path restores the original showOverlay('GALACTIC DEFENDER',...) call that was removed by the PR. v1 path shows the loginOverlay and handles returning-player pre-fill + ldClient.identify(). All login DOM/CSS remains in markup unconditionally (no flash risk). restartGame() loginOverlay clear is unconditional (safe in both paths). Fail-safe default is 'control' so network failures never block the game.
